mapper.select: select d.dept_id as deptId, d.dept_name as deptName, p.dept_name as parentDeptName, d.province, d.city, d.area from sys_dept d left join sys_dept p on d.parent_id = p.dept_id where d.dept_id = #{deptId} and d.del_flag = '0' ${params.dataScope} limit 1

select (select count(1) from fe_fire_point f left join sys_dept d on f.dept_id = d.dept_id where (f.del_flag is null or f.del_flag = '0') ${params.dataScope}) as firePointCount, (select count(1) from fe_gateway g left join sys_dept d on g.dept_id = d.dept_id where (g.del_flag is null or g.del_flag = '0') ${params.dataScope}) as gatewayCount, (select count(1) from fe_sensor s left join sys_dept d on s.dept_id = d.dept_id where (s.del_flag is null or s.del_flag = '0') ${params.dataScope}) as sensorCount, (select count(1) from fe_extinguisher e left join sys_dept d on e.dept_id = d.dept_id where (e.del_flag is null or e.del_flag = '0') ${params.dataScope}) as extinguisherCount

select count(distinct s.sensor_id) as sensorCount, count(distinct case when h.history_id is not null then s.sensor_id end) as reportingSensorCount, count(distinct s.sensor_id) - count(distinct case when h.history_id is not null then s.sensor_id end) as noSampleSensorCount, count(h.history_id) as sampleCount, coalesce(sum(case when h.pressure between 0 and 2000 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as validPressureCount, coalesce(sum(case when h.pressure is not null and (h.pressure < 0 or h.pressure > 2000) then 1 else 0 end), 0) as invalidPressureCount, coalesce(sum(case when h.history_id is not null and h.pressure is null then 1 else 0 end), 0) as missingPressureCount, round(avg(case when h.pressure between 0 and 2000 then h.pressure end), 2) as avgPressure, round(avg(h.temperature), 2) as avgTemperature, round(avg(h.battery_level), 2) as avgBatteryLevel from fe_sensor s left join sys_dept d on s.dept_id = d.dept_id left join fe_sensor_history h on h.sensor_id = s.sensor_id and h.create_time >= #{beginTime} and h.create_time < #{endTime} where (s.del_flag is null or s.del_flag = '0')
${params.dataScope}

select count(distinct g.gateway_id) as gatewayCount, count(distinct case when h.history_id is not null then g.gateway_id end) as reportingGatewayCount, count(distinct g.gateway_id) - count(distinct case when h.history_id is not null then g.gateway_id end) as noGpsGatewayCount, count(h.history_id) as gpsRecordCount from fe_gateway g left join sys_dept d on g.dept_id = d.dept_id left join fe_gateway_gps_history h on h.gateway_id = g.gateway_id and h.gps_time >= #{beginTime} and h.gps_time < #{endTime} where (g.del_flag is null or g.del_flag = '0')
${params.dataScope}

select count(1) as extinguisherCount, coalesce(sum(case when e.last_sync_time >= #{beginTime} and e.last_sync_time < #{endTime} then 1 else 0 end), 0) as syncedCount, coalesce(sum(case when e.production_date is not null and e.extinguisher_type is not null and e.extinguisher_type != '' and e.extinguisher_form is not null and e.extinguisher_form != '' and e.standard_code is not null and e.standard_code != '' and e.temperature_range is not null and e.temperature_range != '' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as profileCompleteCount, coalesce(sum(case when e.production_date is null or e.extinguisher_type is null or e.extinguisher_type = '' or e.extinguisher_form is null or e.extinguisher_form = '' or e.standard_code is null or e.standard_code = '' or e.temperature_range is null or e.temperature_range = '' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as profileIncompleteCount, coalesce(sum(case when e.sensor_id is not null then 1 else 0 end), 0) as boundSensorCount, coalesce(sum(case when e.sensor_id is null then 1 else 0 end), 0) as unboundSensorCount from fe_extinguisher e left join sys_dept d on e.dept_id = d.dept_id where (e.del_flag is null or e.del_flag = '0')
${params.dataScope}

select count(distinct f.fire_point_id) as firePointCount, count(distinct case when h.snapshot_id is not null then f.fire_point_id end) as snapshotCoveredCount, count(distinct f.fire_point_id) - count(distinct case when h.snapshot_id is not null then f.fire_point_id end) as noSnapshotCount, count(h.snapshot_id) as snapshotCount, count(distinct case when f.expected_extinguisher_count is not null and f.expected_extinguisher_count > 0 then f.fire_point_id end) as expectedConfiguredCount from fe_fire_point f left join sys_dept d on f.dept_id = d.dept_id left join fe_fire_point_device_snapshot h on h.fire_point_id = f.fire_point_id and h.snapshot_time >= #{beginTime} and h.snapshot_time < #{endTime} where (f.del_flag is null or f.del_flag = '0')
${params.dataScope}
